source: Four years after the onset of the worst pandemic in 100 years, the weight of the evidence increasingly supports the lab leak hypothesis. Since the Select Subcommittee commenced its work in February 2023, more and more senior intelligence officials, politicians, science editors, and scientists increasingly have endorsed the hypothesis that COVID-19 emerged as the result of a laboratory or research related accident.
translation: 在100年来最严重大流行爆发四年后,越来越多的证据支持实验室泄漏假说。自2023年2月特别小组委员会开始工作以来,越来越多的高级情报官员、政治家、科学编辑和科学家支持新冠病毒是由实验室或研究相关事故产生的假说。
